paras: Look at the colourful bedroom! There are books on the shelf, a bag on the chair, a teddy bear on the bed, and a toy car under the table. In this lesson, you will learn about prepositions (words that tell us where things are), naming words, describing words, and singular and plural words. Look carefully at the picture, discover where the objects are, and have fun learning English!

sections.heading: A. Look at the picture. Write where each thing is. Choose the correct word from the brackets.

items.q: The bat is ______ (on / under) the bed.
items.a: The bat is on the bed.

items.q: The bag is ______ (in / on) the chair.
items.a: The bag is on the chair.

items.q: The ball is ______ (in / under) the box.
items.a: The ball is in the box.

items.q: The car is ______ (in / under) the table.
items.a: The car is under the table.

items.q: The books are ______ (in / on) the shelves.
items.a: The books are on the shelves.

sections.heading: B. Where Are the Things? Choose the correct word from the brackets to complete each sentence.

items.q: The teddy bear is ______ the bed. (on / under)
items.a: The teddy bear is on the bed.

items.q: The pencils are ______ the cup. (in / on)
items.a: The pencils are in the cup.

items.q: The plant is ______ the shelf. (on / under)
items.a: The plant is on the shelf.

items.q: The kite is ______ the wall. (on / in)
items.a: The kite is on the wall.

items.q: The shoes are ______ the chair. (under / on)
items.a: The shoes are under the chair.

items.q: The toy car is ______ the table. (under / on)
items.a: The toy car is under the table.

sections.heading: C1. Look at the picture and write the names of any five things you can see.

items.a: Bed
Bag
Books
Kite
Teddy bear  (other correct answers: chair, table, ball, shoes, socks, pencils, plant, car)

sections.heading: C2. Choose a suitable describing word from the help box to complete each phrase.
sections.note: Help box: blue, colourful, wooden, soft, red.

items.a: Blue bag

items.q: ______ kite
items.a: Colourful kite
Wooden bed

items.q: ______ teddy bear
items.a: Soft teddy bear
Red car

sections.heading: D1. Write the plural form of each naming word.

items.a: books
shoes

items.q: pencil – ______
items.a: pencils
toys

items.q: shelf – ______
items.a: shelves

sections.heading: D2. Complete each sentence using the picture.

items.q: The bag is on the ______.
items.a: The bag is on the chair.

items.q: The books are on the ______.
items.a: The books are on the shelf.

items.q: The ball is inside the ______.
items.a: The ball is inside the box.

items.q: The toy car is under the ______.
items.a: The toy car is under the table.

items.q: The teddy bear is on the ______.
items.a: The teddy bear is on the bed.

sections.heading: D3. Write two sentences about the bedroom using your own words.

items.a: Sample: The blue bag is on the chair.
Sample: The teddy bear is on the bed.
